facts.business: TVS Supply Chain Solutions Limited is a global, integrated, asset-light, and tech-led supply chain solutions provider offering integrated supply chain solutions and global forwarding solutions across industrial, technology, consumer, and other high-growth sectors.
key_risks: Revenue recognition involves significant judgment in determining performance obligations, principal vs agent assessment, allocation of transaction price, and timing of revenue recognition
Impairment of investments in subsidiaries (carrying amount of Rs 2,260.45 crores as at March 31, 2026) requires significant estimation and judgment
Geopolitical developments, shifting trade patterns, and rapid technological change creating complex global environment
facts.related_party_note: Transactions with related parties are in compliance with Sections 177 and 188 of Companies Act, 2013 where applicable and details have been disclosed in the notes to the financial statements as required by applicable accounting standards.
